metadata.description: Ravn's open-source agent plugins: ravn-core for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Pi, and the explain-change, skill-nudge, cc-stretch, and haikrew Claude Code mods.

plugins.name: ravn-core
plugins.description: Core Ravn agent plugin. Bundles reusable skills and MCP server configuration.

plugins.name: explain-change
plugins.description: Shows ravn-core's explain-change lessons in a Claude Code pane: background, intuition, a code walkthrough with text diagrams, and a clickable quiz.

plugins.name: skill-nudge
plugins.description: A background Haiku watches the session and, at the right moment, suggests one of your installed skills above the prompt.

plugins.name: cc-stretch
plugins.description: Ravn's fork of pro-vi/cc-stretch: stretchtext replies that arrive short, with each phrase growing in place when you click it.

plugins.name: haikrew
plugins.description: Ravn's fork of adriancmurray/HaiKrew: token-efficient agent crews where cheap models write, the main model specs and verifies, and hooks keep output small.
